$Comment: A rare war-cry affix, the game's goblin scrapper's pack enrage (Template_Dungeon_Goblin_Scrapper.json) on any scaled mob anywhere. Once the mob turns on a target it stands and cries for WindupSeconds wearing Mmoscaling_Rally_Cry, the warning players see coming, with the scrapper's rally call; then it puts Mmoscaling_Rallied on itself and on every creature within Radius blocks that is hostile to its target, for BuffSeconds, and cries again RepeatMinSeconds to RepeatMaxSeconds later while it still fights. A mob already rallied by another holds its own cry until that runs out. What the buff does lives in Mmoscaling_Rallied; how long it lasts is BuffSeconds here. Weight against the other affixes keeps it rare. Server owners retune it on /zigadmin (War cries), saved in mods/MmoMobScaling/affixes.json; a pack adds another war-cry affix by shipping a file with its own Cry group.
Name: Rallying
